Top 10 FAQs – Scaffolding & Formwork Manufacturer in India
Q1. Who is the leading scaffolding manufacturer in India?
AMCO Exports is a trusted scaffolding manufacturer in India established in 1989, supplying scaffolding systems, accessories and formwork products worldwide.
Q2. What scaffolding products do you manufacture?
We manufacture cuplock scaffolding systems, ledger blades, top cups, bottom cups, props, couplers, clamps, base jacks, U-head jacks and formwork accessories.
Q3. Do you export scaffolding and formwork products?
Yes, AMCO Exports exports scaffolding and formwork materials to multiple countries including the Middle East, Africa, Europe and Asia.
Q4. What is the price of scaffolding materials in India?
Scaffolding prices depend on product type, steel grade, thickness, finish and order quantity. We provide factory-direct bulk pricing for contractors and distributors.
Q5. Which scaffolding system is best for construction projects?
Cuplock scaffolding is widely preferred for construction projects because of its fast installation, strong locking mechanism and high load-bearing capacity.
Q6. Do your scaffolding products follow international standards?
Yes, our scaffolding products are manufactured according to BS1139 and EN74 quality standards for safety and durability.
Q7. What formwork accessories do you manufacture?
We manufacture tie rods, wing nuts, anchor nuts, water stoppers, Waller plates and shuttering clamps for formwork and concrete construction applications.
Q8. Can I order scaffolding accessories directly from factory?
Yes, you can source scaffolding and formwork products directly from our manufacturing facility in Jalandhar, Punjab at competitive factory pricing.
Q9. Which industries use scaffolding systems?
Scaffolding systems are used in construction, bridge projects, refineries, power plants, infrastructure, shipyards and industrial maintenance projects.
Q10. Why choose AMCO Exports for scaffolding and formwork products?
AMCO Exports offers over 35 years of manufacturing experience, export-quality products, bulk production capacity, strict quality control and reliable customer support.
